def extract(path):
    html=open(path).read()
    # geneListing content
    pos=html.find('id=\"geneListing\"')
    seg=html[pos:pos+300000]
    class P(HTMLParser):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__(); self.capture=False; self.table_depth=0; self.in_tr=False; self.in_td=False; self.td=''; self.cells=[]; self.cur=[]; self.rows=[]
        def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
            if tag=='table' and self.capture: self.table_depth+=1
            elif tag=='table' and not self.capture and self.in_gene_section: self.capture=True; self.table_depth=1
            if self.capture and tag=='tr': self.in_tr=True; self.cur=[]
            if self.capture and self.in_tr and tag in ('td','th'): self.in_td=True; self.td=tag; self.cells=[]
        def handle_endtag(self,tag):
            if self.in_td and tag==self.td:
                self.in_td=False; self.cur.append(''.join(self.cells).strip())
            elif self.capture and self.in_tr and tag=='tr':
                self.in_tr=False; self.rows.append(self.cur)
            elif self.capture and tag=='table':
                self.table_depth-=1
                if self.table_depth<=0: self.capture=False
        def handle_data(self,data):
            if self.capture and self.in_td: self.cells.append(data)

    # Need only first table after geneListing. html.parser doesn't handle; simpler parse all.
